answers.core: there aren't any ways of making such change without creating entire new classes just for the property renaming, which may not be a good idea.
answers.workaround:
the aforementioned instruction would still work,
```gdscript
func request_client_start() -> void:
  propagate_call(&"set", ["disabled", true])
  propagate_call(&"set", ["editable", false])
  # [...]
```
but it doesn't feel right that two calls for property changes are being made for the same purpose.

title: Control: rename `editable` into `disabled` for `LineEdit` and related Nodes to match other input `Control`s
